new_today_news.headline: The Great Restaurant Closure Wave of 2026: Who Is Shutting Doors and Why
new_today_news.summary: Major chains including Wendy's (140 closures), Papa John's (200), Pizza Hut (250), Jack in the Box (50-100), and Noodles & Company (30-35) are closing significant numbers of underperforming locations. Persistent inflation, rising labor costs, and changing consumer preferences are driving the wave of consolidation.

new_today_news.headline: Schneider Electric Showcases Technologies Advancing Water Resilience at WEFTEC 2026
new_today_news.summary: Schneider Electric will showcase automation and digital technologies at WEFTEC 2026 during its September 26-30 conference in New Orleans, highlighting water resilience solutions for the wastewater industry.

new_today_news.headline: New ABC Report Finds More Opportunities to Put Wastewater Plants to Work
new_today_news.summary: American Biogas Council released its first comprehensive assessment of anaerobic digestion at U.S. wastewater facilities in over a decade. The report highlights opportunities for co-digestion of organic materials including food waste and fats, oils, and grease (FOG) at 139 wastewater facilities nationwide.

new_today_news.headline: WEFTEC 2026 Opens in New Orleans, Showcasing Innovation, Partnerships, and Collaboration to Solve the World's Toughest Water Challenges
new_today_news.summary: WEFTEC 2026, the Water Environment Federation's premier annual technical exhibition and conference, opens September 26-30 in New Orleans. The event brings together 23,000+ water quality professionals from 100+ countries for technical sessions, workshops, and exhibitions on wastewater treatment and water environment innovation.

recent_news.headline: Survey: How US restaurants are handling inflation, labor, AI, and revenue growth
recent_news.summary: The 2026 Voice of the Restaurant Industry Survey shows 91% of operators rate their business as good or excellent. Inflation (27%) and hiring (22%) remain top challenges, while 87% of operators now feel comfortable using AI in their operations.

recent_news.headline: Greasezilla Builds National FOG Infrastructure Network to Take Processing Burden Off Municipalities
recent_news.summary: Downey Ridge Environmental Company (Greasezilla) announced the operational opening of its second FOG processing hub in Ashland, Virginia, advancing a 30-site national expansion with potential infrastructure value exceeding $150 million. The system processes grease-trap waste without chemicals, recovering materials for renewable fuels and other applications.
